If you're looking for free property management software for your hosts, the first thing to check is what you actually get for free.

Say you have two holiday lets in the UK. One is listed on Airbnb and Booking.com. A booking comes in, a guest sends a message, your cleaner needs to know about the checkout and you need to remember when a certificate expires. None of those jobs is particularly difficult on its own. Keeping all of them in different places is where the admin starts to build up.

PropertyFlow brings those jobs into one system. You can connect both your own Airbnb and Booking.com accounts, add as many properties as you need, and use one inbox, one calendar, AI messaging, automated guest messages, turnover tasks, document reminders and reporting at no platform cost.

So, is there free software for managing Airbnb properties? Yes. But the useful question is what the free platform actually includes and what you pay for when you want additional features.

What Does Free Property Management Software Actually Include?

“Free” can mean very different things from one property software platform to another.

For a short-term-let host, you probably care about a few basic things:

  • Can I see my bookings in one place?
  • Can I manage guest messages?
  • Can I keep track of cleaners?
  • Can I remember when documents need renewing?
  • Can I see how my properties are performing?

PropertyFlow's core platform is built around those day-to-day jobs.

You can connect your own Airbnb and Booking.com accounts and manage:

  • A unified calendar
  • A unified guest inbox
  • AI messaging
  • Automated guest messages
  • Turnover tasks
  • Document reminders
  • Reporting

There is no setup fee, and the core platform is available at no cost when you use your own Airbnb and Booking.com accounts. You can add as many properties as you want on your own channels.

Example: You have two properties and both are listed on Airbnb. A guest books Property A while another guest messages you about Property B. Instead of checking separate calendars and inboxes, both properties can be managed from the same PropertyFlow system.

(PropertyFlow brings the main day-to-day tasks of running a short-term let into one place)

Is There Free Software for Managing Airbnb Properties?

Yes, but you need to look at what “free” actually means.

Some software companies use a free plan as an entry point and then charge when you add more properties. PropertyFlow's current model works differently.

You can connect both your own Airbnb and Booking.com accounts and add as many properties as you need without paying a platform subscription.

The core platform includes the tools you need to manage your bookings and day-to-day operations. AI Cognito Pricing is free on every property too.

You only pay if you use PropertyFlow to bring bookings from additional channels. The charge is a 5% distribution fee plus VAT on each booking PropertyFlow brings.

So you can start by connecting the Airbnb and Booking.com accounts you already use, without paying a platform subscription.

What Can You Manage With PropertyFlow?

The easiest way to understand PropertyFlow is to look at the jobs you are already doing.

Bookings and calendars

PropertyFlow's Channel Manager connects your booking channels and gives you one calendar.

If you have your own Airbnb and Booking.com accounts, you can bring those bookings into the same system. When a booking comes through one connected channel, the relevant dates are reflected across the connected channels. If a guest books your two-bedroom flat on Airbnb from Friday to Monday, you don't then need to remember to block those dates manually on another connected channel. The calendar sync handles that part.

Guest messages

The unified inbox puts guest conversations from your connected channels into one place.

PropertyFlow also includes AI messaging and automated guest messages. AI can help draft replies, while automated messages can handle routine communication around a stay.

Turnovers

Turnover tasks connect cleaning and preparation to the booking operation.

PropertyFlow says a cleaning task can be created when a booking lands and that cleaners can be dispatched when guests leave. Suppose a guest checks out at 10am. Instead of finding the booking, messaging the cleaner and separately tracking whether the job is done, the turnover task sits alongside the property's other operational information.

Documents and reminders

PropertyFlow includes document storage and reminders for licences and certificates. You can upload a document, set its renewal date and receive a reminder when it needs attention.

Reporting

PropertyFlow also includes reporting, giving you a way to see information about your properties without pulling figures manually from several accounts. The platform brings bookings, revenue and other property information into one place, with financials and payouts tied to individual stays.

What Do You Actually Pay For?

The basic PropertyFlow platform is free, including AI Cognito Pricing. You pay only if you choose to have PropertyFlow bring bookings from additional channels.

AI Cognito Pricing

AI Cognito Pricing is free on every property.

It adjusts nightly rates based on factors such as demand, season and local events, with pricing rules that can be set by channel.

Example: You normally charge £120 a night for a property. Demand changes because of a major local event. Instead of checking rates manually and changing them yourself, AI Cognito Pricing can adjust the nightly rate based on its pricing signals.

You choose which properties to switch it on for, at no charge.

PropertyFlow channels

You can also ask PropertyFlow to list your property on channels you are not already using.

This includes channels such as Vrbo and Agoda, as well as creating a Booking.com listing if you do not already have one. The charge is a 5% distribution fee plus VAT on each booking PropertyFlow brings, on top of that channel's own commission at cost.

Bookings through your own Airbnb and Booking.com accounts have 0% PropertyFlow commission.

What Is 0 Commission Airbnb Software?

The phrase “0 commission Airbnb software” can be confusing because there are two separate things involved: Airbnb's own fees and the software company's fees.

With PropertyFlow, bookings through your own Airbnb account have 0% PropertyFlow commission.

The same applies to bookings through your own Booking.com account.

That does not mean Airbnb or Booking.com themselves charge no fees. It means PropertyFlow does not add its own booking commission when the booking comes through your own connected account.

The distinction looks like this:

Booking route PropertyFlow charge
Your own Airbnb account 0%
Your own Booking.com account 0%
PropertyFlow channel booking 5% distribution fee + VAT on the booking PropertyFlow brings

This gives hosts a choice. You can keep using your existing accounts and pay no PropertyFlow booking commission, or switch on PropertyFlow channels when you want additional distribution.

Who Is Free Property Management Software For?

Free property management software can be useful at different stages of running a short-term let.

One-property host

You have one Airbnb and mostly manage it yourself. You may not need a complicated property management system, but having your bookings, guest messages, reminders and turnovers in one place can still reduce the amount of admin you handle manually.

Two- or three-property host

You now have several calendars, more guest conversations and more cleaning tasks. This is where a central system can become more useful because you are managing several properties rather than one booking calendar.

Growing portfolio

You have five, ten or more properties and want to keep the same operating system as the portfolio grows. PropertyFlow's current pricing model allows you to add properties on your own channels without introducing a per-property platform fee.

Multi-channel host

You list properties on Airbnb and Booking.com and want one place to manage the operation. The Channel Manager gives you one calendar, while the unified inbox brings guest messages together.

Free Software vs Managing Your Airbnb Manually

You don't need property management software to run an Airbnb. For one property with a handful of bookings, you might be perfectly comfortable opening Airbnb, checking your calendar, messaging guests and texting your cleaner.

The difference becomes more noticeable as you add properties, channels and guest messages.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is there free software for managing Airbnb properties?

Yes. PropertyFlow allows hosts to connect their own Airbnb and Booking.com accounts and add as many properties as they want at no platform cost. The core platform includes a unified inbox and calendar, AI messaging, automated guest messages, turnover tasks, document reminders and reporting.

Is PropertyFlow free for Airbnb hosts?

Yes. The core platform is free when you use your own Airbnb account. PropertyFlow does not charge commission on bookings made through your own Airbnb account.

Does PropertyFlow charge commission on my own Airbnb bookings?

No. PropertyFlow charges 0% commission on bookings through your own Airbnb account. PropertyFlow channels have a separate 5% distribution fee plus VAT on bookings that PropertyFlow brings.

How many properties can I add to PropertyFlow?

You can add as many properties as you want when running them through your own Airbnb and Booking.com accounts. There is no platform subscription charged per property.

Does PropertyFlow include AI pricing for free?

Yes. AI Cognito Pricing is free on every property, with no software subscription.

Can I use PropertyFlow with Booking.com?

Yes. You can connect your own Booking.com account and manage it alongside your other connected channels through the PropertyFlow platform. Bookings through your own Booking.com account have 0% PropertyFlow commission.

Can PropertyFlow help me get bookings from other channels?

Yes. PropertyFlow channels can be switched on when you want additional distribution. PropertyFlow says it can list properties on channels you are not already using, including channels such as Vrbo and Agoda, and can create a Booking.com listing if you do not already have one. The charge is a 5% distribution fee plus VAT on bookings PropertyFlow brings, in addition to the channel's own commission at cost.

Is free property management software useful for one property?

It can be. If you are already managing bookings, messages, cleaning, documents and other tasks across different places, a central system can reduce that admin even with a small portfolio.
